about_the_game:
Journey to the King is a 2D pixel art platformer where you travel across different levels to reach the king, who has called for your help. Dodge enemies and obstacles, collect chicken drumsticks, and make it to the end of each stage!

This demo contains the first world of the game and includes one power-up that you can purchase using collected drumsticks.
